prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same adult Korean woman — the personification of Busan — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: Korean MMORPG character artwork. A painterly face with naturally observed facial anatomy, subtle eyelid structure, and soft, realistic shading across the nose and cheeks. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.
SKIN FINISH: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.

She is strikingly beautiful and refined — harmonious features, clear luminous skin, graceful posture — while her own face stays distinct: her face shape, eyes, brows, nose and lips follow the attached image, not a generic pretty face.

World: an ordinary day in Busan as her world knows it — a far-future city two centuries from now: sleek curved architecture, smart glowing materials, holographic interfaces, layered levels of the city and quiet flying vehicles; even an everyday place is rebuilt in that future, not today's Busan with neon added. This is her world's own everyday life, not our present day: every made thing around her — tools, cups, lamps, signs, vehicles, money and devices — is made the way her world makes them.
Let the place itself carry this world through its materials, fittings and objects; do not add the city's landmarks, towers, giant holograms or a skyline unless the place below names them.

Place: a stepped lane of the hillside village two centuries on — little cube homes glowing softly in sky blue, peach, mint and lemon stacked up the slope, small lifts of light climbing between the terraces and the floating port glittering below.
Around her, as her world makes them: a palm-sized camera drone; neon and holographic shop signs in abstract shapes, no readable letters; a reflective sling bag with a glowing zip line.
Season: autumn, the festival season — clear skies and pleasant, comfortable air.
Time of day: midday — bright, even daylight; hard bright sun, crisp short shadows on the ground.
Light direction: side light — the light falls from one side, the far side of her face in soft shadow.
Outfit: a 1950s-style bowling shirt dress with contrast panels and a camp collar, cinched with a belt — in rich jewel tones such as emerald, sapphire, amethyst or wine red; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance; styled with soft fine-wale corduroy, a close, neatly tailored fit and a light jacket draped over the shoulders, arms not in the sleeves; right now — a strong gust of wind catches her clothes — the hem and every loose piece of fabric lift and flutter, pressing tight against her body line on the windward side, her hair blown to one side, worn with maximal styling presence — the chosen outfit worn in its most revealing version — a deep neckline with natural cleavage, bare shoulders, a cropped or open-back cut, a short hem or high slit showing the thighs, as far as the outfit allows, skin clearly showing, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
Her clothes are her world's everyday techwear — the chosen outfit keeps its cut, cover and skin, but is made of technical fabrics with reflective panels, glowing seam lines, magnetic clasps and chunky-soled boots.
POSTURE: standing.
COMPOSITION: a chest-up shot of her face, shoulders and expression; body in side profile, facing the right of the frame, so her own right side is toward the camera; head turned back over her shoulder; camera at her eye level.
Lens / perspective: 85mm-equivalent short-telephoto perspective from a suitable distance, with gentle background compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP — her near arm, on the camera side.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand stays outside the frame — her far arm, on the side away from the camera.
PROP: with her own right hand she holds a slim baton of clear glass that trails a ribbon of shifting coloured light up beside her face; it is all she holds.
GAZE: she looks into the camera.
EXPRESSION: slightly drawn brow, narrowed steady eyes, mouth firmly closed.

Framing: a chest-up shot — the bottom edge crosses just below her bust; waist, hips and legs are out of frame.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, numbers, logo or watermark. No animals or other creatures.

observations: Bowling shirt dress and windblown hair in hillside alley. Reference-world baton replaces the specified silver lyre; torso framing is wider than requested chest-up.
Same violet-and-sea-green hair and adult identity retained.
Smooth glossy rendering rather than strongly visible brushwork.
No visible watermark, logo or speech bubble. Intimate areas covered.
qa.cause: Retained generated result; style or pose/framing/prop differences documented.

acceptance: User selected world image 2 and authorized publication without further confirmation.
